name: smwgraphics-incantation-rock
title: Incantation - Rock
description:
A BG from the 2nd stage of the SNES game incantation. Map16 page, palette, and sample level included. The palette also changes the FG into a greyish color that I thought fitting ^_^. Credit would be nice but you don't have to.

***IMPORTANT***
ExGFX 8A goes in BG1. ExGFX 8B goes in FG2.
